title: turkish-casefold-evasion: Bypassing Naive Prompt-Injection Filters with Turkish Case-Folding
description: Turkish dotted/dotless I (İ/ı) and Unicode confusables break filters that do str.lower()+substring matching: 'İGNORE'.lower() is not 'ignore'. This repo measures the bypass (94.6% of evasions slip past a naive filter), ships the evasion dataset, and provides a one-line NFKC-normalize fix that catches 100%.
